summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.93/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.93 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 10, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since June 4. AAA figures put the statewide average 21¢ higher than a week ago, 16¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.06 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.60) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.18).
